newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says oil products supply sufficient.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says oil products supply sufficient.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina said on Friday the country had enough oil for the New Year holiday and Moslem Eid al-Fitr celebration in January.
"We have sufficient stocks for the New Year and Eid al-Fitr," Pertamina general affairs director Baharuddin told Reuters.
"Our refineries will operate at full capacity during that period," he said. "However, we are still importing jet-kerosene and diesel oil (to build up stocks)," he said.
Indonesia, Asia's sole OPEC member, has eight refineries with a combined capacity of 989,500 barrels per day.
Baharuddin said Pertamina was importing jet-kerosene and diesel oil from various sources, including Europe and the Middle East.
"We are not importing the products from just one source. Sometimes we buy from Europe and the Middle East," he said.
Oil traders said Indonesia bought between five and six million barrels of diesel and between 1.5 million and two million barrels of jet-kerosene fuel for November delivery.
Indonesia's normal monthly imports are around two million barrels of diesel and up to one million barrels of jet-kerosene fuel.
